steps.title: At least one red counter
steps.body: At least one red counter is still in the bag unless all 3 red counters are taken.

steps.title: So use the complement
steps.body:
So use the complement:

\[
P(\text{all 3 red are taken})
=\frac{3}{12}\cdot\frac{2}{11}\cdot\frac{1}{10}
\]

\[
=\frac{6}{1320}
\]

\[
=\frac{1}{220}
\]

steps.title: Therefore,
steps.body:
Therefore,

\[
P(\text{at least one red is still in the bag})
=1-\frac{1}{220}
\]

\[
=\frac{219}{220}
\]

\]
